purpose: Catalog net-new data-bearing sources that can make the MouldMaster Book more quantitative without converting case-specific observations into universal recipes.

baseline.rule: Do not duplicate existing profiled datasets. Measured experiments, simulations, vendor-grade guidance and article-only tables remain separate evidence classes.

candidates.title: Experiment-Driven Gaussian Process Surrogate Modeling and Bayesian Optimization for Multi-Objective Injection Molding
candidates.rightsState: CC-BY-4.0 article; verify any bulk extraction/redistribution implementation before committing derived raw tables
measurementNotes: warpage by CMM at 0.01 mm resolution
cycle time from machine controller at 0.01 s resolution
weight after 24 h stabilization at 0.1 mg readability
candidates.value: Highest-priority new source: complete physical experimental table supports worked DOE, correlation, trade-off and measurement examples.
candidates.limitations: One HDPE part/machine/mould study; numerical ranges are case evidence, not transferable setpoints.

candidates.title: Transfer and Optimisation of Injection Moulding Manufacture of Medical Devices Using Scientific Moulding Principles
candidates.rightsState: open-access article; verify figure/table reuse details at implementation
candidates.scale: machine-transfer case with rheology, pressure-loss, cavity-balance, gate-freeze, cooling and 32-shot verification studies
candidates.value: Excellent end-to-end worked scientific-moulding example showing how several studies connect into a robust transfer decision.
candidates.limitations: Medical-device PP/HDPE overmoulding case; study values remain specific to the actual machines, mould and product.

candidates.title: Utilizing Simulation Software to Develop Injection Molding Process Windows with High-Impact Polystyrene
candidates.rightsState: CC-BY-4.0 article; supplement available; verify exact supplement terms/files before ingestion
candidates.scale: filling and packing process-window study with physical validation on a 180-ton Sumitomo machine
candidates.value: Strong teaching bridge between CAE-predicted operating windows and physical verification; reported dimensional shrinkage prediction within about 1% for the studied part.
candidates.limitations: HIPS/ASTM-mould study; data mix simulation and measurement and must be labelled by origin.

candidates.title: Experimental Development of an Injection Molding Process Window
candidates.rightsState: CC-BY-4.0 article; extract only with attribution and context
candidates.scale: experimental process-window construction around selected control variables and performance measures
candidates.value: Worked example for showing that a process window is an experimentally delimited region rather than a nominal setting.
candidates.limitations: Case-specific process and performance measures; no generic packing-pressure boundary may be inferred.

candidates.title: In-cavity pressure measurements for failure diagnosis in the injection moulding process and correlation with numerical simulation
candidates.rightsState: open-access article; verify exact licence before figure/table redistribution
candidates.scale: instrumented mould failure-diagnosis case with cavity-pressure profiles and simulation comparison
candidates.value: High-value diagnostic case because pressure-curve interpretation is tied to visible failures and mould/process hypotheses instead of a single symptom-to-cause rule.
candidates.limitations: One instrumented overmoulding case; simulation agreement does not make the pressure features universal thresholds.

candidates.title: Multiple In-Mold Sensors for Quality and Process Control in Injection Molding
candidates.scale: multi-cavity in-mould pressure experiments covering clamp, switchover and holding-phase decisions
candidates.value: Directly supports worked pressure-integral, cavity-balance and gate-freeze reasoning with multiple sensor locations.
candidates.limitations: Reported freeze/holding behaviour belongs to the studied gate/material/thermal system only.

candidates.title: Tie-Bar Elongation Based Filling-To-Packing Switchover Control and Prediction of Injection Molding Quality
candidates.value: Adds a quantitative example of how switchover timing changes cavity-pressure/clamp response and how an external machine signal can be used as evidence.
candidates.limitations: Machine/mould-specific response; do not convert the study's switchover positions or pressures into recommended settings.

candidates.title: Research on Quality Characterization Method of Micro-Injection Products Based on Cavity Pressure
candidates.value: Useful worked correlation example showing that pressure-curve area may carry more quality information than a single peak in a studied micro-moulding case.
candidates.limitations: Micro-injection context and study-specific correlations; correlation is not root-cause proof.

candidates.title: Real-time product weight estimation based on internal pressure monitoring in injection molding
candidates.rightsState: verify-before-reuse; do not redistribute figures/tables/raw values until exact article licence is confirmed
candidates.value: Adds cross-material evidence for pressure-integral/weight saturation modelling and in-cycle quality estimation.
candidates.limitations: Material/mould-specific freeze behaviour; rights must be resolved before any raw extraction.

candidates.title: Out-of-Mold Sensor-Based Process Parameter Optimization and Adaptive Process Quality Control for Hot Runner Thin-Walled Injection-Molded Parts
candidates.value: Strong real-world-style example of sensor-derived process indexes and adaptive control for a hot-runner thin-wall process.
candidates.limitations: Adaptive-control results are implementation-specific and do not establish universal alarm/control limits.

candidates.title: Development of Artificial Neural Network System to Recommend Process Conditions of Injection Molding for Various Geometries
candidates.rightsState: raw dataset availability/redistribution not confirmed; article evidence only until supplement/source is located
candidates.scale: 3600 simulations across 36 moulds plus 476 physical experiments across 11 moulds
candidates.features: 5 process + 15 geometry inputs; part weight output
candidates.value: Unusually useful for teaching why geometry context matters and why models trained on one mould do not automatically transfer to another.
candidates.limitations: Do not count 3600 simulations as measured cycles; raw experimental dataset availability remains unresolved.

candidates.title: Injection Molding Simulations v5
candidates.rightsState: verify exact Zenodo licence metadata before automated ingestion
candidates.scale: 624 VTU geometry simulations using Autodesk Moldflow 2023 and Celanese Factor PP GF30
candidates.value: Large field-level corpus for visual/interactive teaching of spatial process phenomena that are difficult to obtain as open physical measurements.
candidates.limitations: Simulation only. Never present fields as measured shop-floor ground truth.

candidates.title: Research on Bi-Objective Optimization of Injection Molding Process and Mechanical Anisotropy of Glass Fiber-Reinforced Polypropylene Fan Face Shell Based on RSM and NSGA-II
candidates.scale: 86-run CCD response table plus full-scale mould-trial validation
candidates.value: Rich reinforced-polymer example connecting process variables, orientation, warpage, residual stress and measured validation.
candidates.limitations: The 86-run table is Moldflow-derived response data, not 86 physical moulding trials; physical validation is a separate evidence layer.

candidates.title: Optimizing the plastic injection molding process and reducing warpage through response surface methodology
candidates.value: Small reusable RSM/warpage dataset suitable for worked statistical examples.
candidates.limitations: Moldex3D-driven simulation data; keep separate from physical dimensional measurements.

candidates.title: Covestro Makrolon FR6902 grade processing and property data
candidates.rightsState: reference-only unless reuse terms explicitly permit republication
candidates.value: Excellent example of what grade-specific supplier data looks like and why it must not be generalized to a polymer family.
candidates.limitations: Vendor recommendations are reference conditions for this grade and application context, not Book defaults.

candidates.title: Celanese Polyester Technical Manual — melt-flow and shrinkage examples
candidates.rightsState: reference-only unless reuse terms explicitly permit republication
dataClasses: flow length versus wall thickness/injection pressure for Celanex 3300
candidates.value: Useful visual example connecting wall thickness, flow length and injection pressure, alongside an explicit manufacturer warning against using standard-bar shrinkage directly for tool sizing.
candidates.limitations: Older manufacturer manual and grade/family-specific examples; confirm current grade documentation before production use.
